description: The traceback points at parse_amount, but the root cause is clean_number in another file.

issue.title: Entering 1,299.50 as an invoice amount crashes
issue.body:
Adding an invoice line with the amount `$1,299.50` fails:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "billing/invoice.py", line 11, in add_line
    amount = parse_amount(raw)
  File "billing/money.py", line 9, in parse_amount
    return float(cleaned)
ValueError: could not convert string to float: '1,299.50'
```

Amounts without a thousands separator work fine.
